tweet: "I just don't know what to do. I don't know who I am. And I don't know how to do right by others. I feel like a fuckup and an inconvenience."

"I think i'm confusing expressing myself honestly with over-sharing and trauma dumping. And I absolutely need to stop doing that. But I have a hard time working out what a good compromise iswhat I can share and what I shouldn't ..."

"And I can't help but think that maybe she should; that she'd be happier and things would be simpler.  After an incredibly rough day for both of us, she said she doesn't want to hear as much of my problems. That it's too much ..."

"I tried not to let it bother me but eventually expressed my concern. Naturally, it upset her which led me to apologize and say I'd overreacted.  I genuinely worry that she'll return to her husband ..."

"I fear she was too hasty moving cross-country to be with me. I think she's full of regrets but doesn't know how to end it. I know she missed her family terribly. I realized late last year she was talking regularly with her ex ..."

"But I must be oversharing. Trauma-dumping. We promised each other we would always communicate openly and honestly. But I think I'm doing it to excess. I desperately want her to be honest with me but I know she isn't 100% available and doesn't full trust me ..."

"I'm feeling lost. My partner has accused me several times of gaslighting her. And I have to believe her. When she points it out, it absolutely knocks me on my butt. I truly don't believe I'm doing it intentionally. I'm trying so hard to communicate my thoughts and needs ..."
"Revisiting my first tweet and OUCH."
"This is not a cry for help. This is me venting. Screaming into the void. I'm not even strong enough to put these thoughts in front of my therapist."
"I don't know who I am."

"I'm immensely tired of letting myself and other people down. I've repeatedly alienated myself from family and friends. I seem incapable of maintaining meaningful relationships. My child is thoroughly messed up and I feel powerless to help them. I don't know what to do."

"I've chalked up so many mistakes throughout my life. Bad ones. They feel insurmountable. Even though I've tried to face them head on. I'm simply not strong enough. So what's the point? I'm simply not cut out for, well, existing. I do not like myself. At all."

"Honestly, I'm fighting the urge to run away and hide. From everything. And everyone. Just... disappear. The urge to unalive myself is steadily growing. I feel strongly that people in my life would be so much happier and healthier without me around."
"I do not know how to be neurodivergent. I'm looking back at my life with regret and frustration and so much anger. I do not know how to move past this."

"I have a history of issues and trauma when it comes to my sexuality and love life. To the point where I'm confident I may be asexual. My partner is a very sexual person and I'm failing them in that regard. The guilt is suffocating and overwhelming."

"I am incredibly tired of being insecure but I don't know how else to be. My partner is bitterly unhappy and has been since I met them. I have to assume it's because of me in many ways: that, clearly, I do not make them happy."

"The moment your partner says something is wrong or they're not okay *BUT* they don't want to talk about it, how exactly are you supposed to carry on your day? How do you just sit on that without spiralling and assuming the worst?"

"Sometimes something happensa loved one says somethingand, immediately, it triggers red flags and alarm bells. It immediately calls into question everything you thought you knew and held true. Or, at least, *wanted* to be true ..."
"I will crush on anyone who shows me attention, expresses concern, or uses a heart emoji in their responses."

"I've reached the stage where I have no idea who I am anymore and the more I try to work it out, the darker and fuzzier my core gets and the harder it is to remain present  I've lost all confidence and sense of self."
"A melancholy day spent mostly in my own thoughts. Beating myself up for things I can't control while well aware I'm overthinking EVERYTHING."
"I am laying next to my partner in bed. They are snoring fitfully and I'm quietly crying. I will be okay but, right now, I am not okay."
"I do not know how to express to loved ones that I'm having a really difficult time. I'm tired of masking."
"I tried unmasking around my closest friends during Thanksgiving and it did not go well at all. I felt ashamed and self-conscious. And shall continue to exhaust myself by masking."

"I've been diagnosed with bipolar II (manic depression) and GAD but both can be linked to or masked by ADHD. I've been made to feel like I'm collecting diagnoses/labels when all I really want is to understand WTF is wrong with me."
"It's been that way my entire life and those around me are clearly disappointed and frustrated. But I can't just not be forgetful. So I continue to beat myself up as I upset those closest to me."

"How many of my symptoms have nothing to do with ADHD and are just normal? Hearing loss and memory are getting worse and my partner thinks it's normal and nothing to be concerned about (especially my memory) ..."

"But, when I forget simple thingsespecially things they've told me or we've discussedthey grow angry and disappointed and I feel guilty and miserable. But there's no way past that because of course it upsets and frustrates them."

"Realizing your brain isn't wired for healthy relationships is soul crushing. The harder I tried, the more I obsessed over my actions ... It's clear now why all my relationships have failed. It was always me. I've been unhealthy for everyone who grew close to me. Ouch."
